fn build_gateway_announcement(
    route_hints: Vec<RouteHint>,
    ttl: std::time::Duration,
    fees: RoutingFees,
    lightning_context: LightningContext,
    api: SafeUrl,
    gateway_id: PublicKey,
    federation_index: u64,
    redeem_key: PublicKey,
) -> LightningGatewayAnnouncement {
    let fee_amount = lightning_context
        .convert_fee(fees.base_fee_msat, fees.proportional_fee_millionth)
        .unwrap_or_default();

    LightningGatewayAnnouncement {
        route_hints,
        ttl,
        fee_amount,
        lightning_context,
        api,
        gateway_id,
        federation_index,
        redeem_key,
    }
}

fn result_to_option<T, E>(env: &mut Env, rename: Option<&'static str>) -> String
where
    T: OCamlDesc,
    E: OCamlDesc,
{
    let name = rename.unwrap_or("result_to_option");
    let option_type = env.type_name("Option");
    let result_type = env.type_name("Result");

    let t_name = env.type_name::<T>();
    let e_name = env.type_name::<E>();

    let mut code = String::new();
    code.push_str(
        concat!(
            "type ",
            name,
            " = ",
            option_type,
            "<",
            t_name,
            ">\n\n",
            "let ",
            name,
            " (r : ",
            result_type,
            "<",
            t_name,
            ", ",
            e_name,
            ">): ",
            option_type,
            "<",
            t_name,
            "> =\n",
            "  match r with\n",
            "  | Ok x -> Some x\n",
            "  | Err _ -> None\n\n"
        ),
    );

    code
}

fn notify_block_with_reward_summary(
    notifier: &BlockMetadataNotifierImpl,
    parent_slot: u64,
    parent_blockhash: &str,
    slot: u64,
    blockhash: &str,
    rewards: &KeyedRewardsAndNumPartitions,
    block_time: Option<UnixTimestamp>,
    block_height: Option<u64>,
    executed_transaction_count: u64,
    entry_count: u64,
) {
    let total_reward_lamports = rewards
        .rewards
        .iter()
        .map(|(account, &lamports)| lamports)
        .sum::<u64>();

    notifier.notify_block(
        parent_slot,
        parent_blockhash,
        slot,
        blockhash,
        total_reward_lamports,
        block_time,
        block_height,
        executed_transaction_count,
        entry_count,
    );
}

fn glue_type_to_bson_type(data_type: &gluesql_core::prelude::DataType) -> Option<&'static str> {
    match data_type {
        DataType::Int => Some("integer"),
        DataType::BigInt => Some("integer"),
        DataType::SmallInt => Some("integer"),
        DataType::TinyInt => Some("integer"),
        DataType::Bool => Some("boolean"),
        DataType::String => Some("string"),
        DataType::VarChar => Some("string"),
        DataType::Char => Some("string"),
        DataType::Binary => Some("binary"),
        DataType::Blob => Some("binary"),
        DataType::Timestamp => Some("date"),
        DataType::Date => Some("date"),
        DataType::Time => Some("date"),
        DataType::Decimal => Some("number"),
        DataType::Float => Some("number"),
        DataType::Double => Some("number"),
        DataType::Json => Some("object"),
        DataType::Uuid => Some("string"),
        DataType::Array => Some("array"),
        DataType::Map => Some("object"),
        DataType::Enum(_) => Some("string"),
        DataType::Struct(_) => Some("object"),
        DataType::Variant(_) => Some("object"),
        _ => None,
    }
}
